en-GB.title: Fe3dr Vendor: Sell Food
en-GB.subtitle: Run your home kitchen
en-GB.description:
The companion app for home chefs selling on Fe3dr.

Take orders, publish your menu, and get paid — from the kitchen, on your phone. Fe3dr Vendor is for FSSAI-licensed home chefs who already sell on Fe3dr; you will need an approved chef account to sign in.

ORDERS
• New orders arrive with a push notification
• Accept or decline, and set your own prep time
• Mark ready, hand to a rider, or deliver yourself
• Confirm delivery with an OTP from the customer

YOUR MENU
• Add dishes with photos, prices, dietary tags and allergens
• Set a fixed weekly menu for tiffin customers, with veg and non-veg options for each day
• Publish a different menu for each date when you want to cook something else
• Build thalis and combos from dishes you already have
• Choose which days each dish is available

CAPACITY AND HOURS
• Cap how many portions you will cook per slot, so you never oversell
• Set your kitchen hours and pause when you need a day off
• Choose delivery, pickup, or both

EARNINGS
• See what you have earned, per order and per week
• Track payouts through to your bank account
• Commission and deductions shown in full, with nothing hidden

GETTING SET UP
• Guided onboarding for your kitchen details and documents
• Upload your FSSAI licence and identity documents from your phone
• Track your approval status as you go

Available in English and Hindi. Fe3dr operates in India.

Questions? support@fe3dr.com

review.notes:
Fe3dr Vendor is the companion app for home chefs selling on Fe3dr, a marketplace for home-cooked food in India.

This app REQUIRES AN APPROVED CHEF ACCOUNT — there is no public sign-up that reaches the main app, because a chef must pass FSSAI licence and identity checks before they can sell. The demo account below is pre-approved with a published menu and at least one order, so every screen is reachable.

It manages an existing real-world business relationship between the chef and the platform. It is not a standalone product and has no consumer-facing purchase flow, so In-App Purchase does not apply (guideline 3.1.1). Chefs are paid out to their bank account; they never pay through the app.

LOCATION is requested once, during onboarding, only to autofill the kitchen address. It is optional — the address can be typed instead — and the app never uses location in the background.

CAMERA AND PHOTOS are used for dish photos and for uploading the FSSAI licence and identity documents.

ACCOUNT DELETION: More > Settings > Pause or delete account. Confirm by typing the account email. Also available at https://fe3dr.com/account-deletion.

The app is offered in India only. The interface is available in English and Hindi.
